messages:
maya: Heads up - invoice preview anomalies spotted for several midsize tenants. Big token counts (~2-5M tokens) appear under "(unattributed)" starting ~02:07 UTC after we enabled the new embedding-batcher on canary. Console shows no per-route rows for those windows. Anyone seen?

aj: seeing it. Dashboards show a jump but route labels are blank. Quick grep of raw ingest shows merged batch envelopes missing route metadata.

kevin: that tracks with the embedding-batcher change. We changed to coalesce requests into a single envelope to reduce per-token overhead; looks like we didn't propagate `route_tag` when coalescing.

sam: do we have an example event we can paste (sanitized)?

aj: paste below (sanitized):

```
{"tenant_id":"acct_42","batch_id":"b_2026_11_07","requests":8,"tokens_total":2143456,"model":"embed-2"}
```

no `route_tag` or per-item ids in the envelope. previously each item had headers with route info.

lucy: options: 1) add route meta to batch envelope (cheap) 2) keep per-item headers inside envelope (medium) 3) emit a split per-item side-stream for accounting (expensive).

maya: key question: is route resolution deterministic for all items in the batch? if yes, envelope-level tag is fine. if not, we need per-item attribution.

kevin: not deterministic. The batch is handed to backends which may shard items across lanes for parallelism. So a single envelope might map to multiple backend routes.

aj: proposal: add two optional fields to the batch envelope: `route_tags` (list) and `route_resolution_mode` with values `single`, `multi`, or `unknown`. If single, aggregator attributes to that tag. If multi, aggregator expects a compact per-item attribution side-channel or marks as unresolved.

sam: I like that because it makes intent explicit. Also surface `route_resolution_mode` in the invoice preview UI so CS/Finance see why numbers are incomplete. Right now they just see a blank which triggers support tickets.

lucy: ingest schema change is small but we must be careful with consumers swallowing unknowns. We'll add fields as optional and ship tolerant parsers.

aj: aggregator action items: make parser tolerant (default unresolved attribution), emit metric `metering.unattributed_batches_total`, add alert if rate > 1/min for >5min. I can do this today.

ingest-bot: deploy: embedding-batcher v1.3.0 enabled coalesce mode on canary at 02:05 UTC.

maya: matches. rough impact window matches canary rollout.

kevin: backfill/backout plan? We may need to reprocess raw edge logs to reconstruct per-item attribution for affected tenants. Do those raw logs keep per-item headers before coalescing?

lucy: canary edge nodes keep pre-coalesced request traces for 12 hours in raw logs. Non-canary nodes do not. So we can reconstruct for canary traffic only.

sam: recommend we: 1) identify tenants with preview delta > $30 or token delta > 500k in the window; 2) attempt reconstruction from raw logs for those tenants; 3) surface proposed delta in preview UI with manual accept by finance. Don't auto-apply.

maya: agree. Finance prefers manual confirmation for any invoice adjustments.

kevin: long-term, we should either pin routing early (before batching) or stream lightweight per-item routing hints through the batch envelope (not full headers, just route ids). That avoids ambiguity while keeping batching efficiency.

lucy: will draft an RFC for a minimal per-item route vector in the batch envelope (like an array of route_ids compressed) for next sprint.

aj: for the immediate mitigation I'll: 1) add tolerant aggregator parsing + metric and alert, 2) add `unattributed` bucket in invoice preview with explanation tooltip, 3) post a runbook entry. ETA EOD for parser+metric and tomorrow for UI badge.

maya: Lucy, can you gate a proxy fix behind a feature flag so we can roll to prod when ready? Kevin/Sam handle backfill scope and finance outreach. I'll create incident ticket and coordinate comms with CS.

ingest-bot: incident created: INC-4129 "Unattributed token spike after embedding-batcher coalesce change" assigned eng-platform.

kevin: also let's add a small dashboard tile for `metering.unattributed_tokens` and `metering.unattributed_batches`. Put it in SRE runbook.

lucy: noted. I'll start the proxy PR with a feature flag to include `route_resolution_mode` + optional `route_tags` field. Tests included.

maya: great. Thanks all. keep updates in the ticket and drop PR links here when ready.

aj: putting up PR for tolerant parser now: link when ready.
